experience.label: THE JOURNEY
experience.title: Built along the way.
experience.intro: Different teams, different challenges. Always something to learn.

items.body: Modernization across web and mobile. Shared standards, testing, and observability with an international team.

contributions.title: Giving legacy systems a new direction.
contributions.body: Restructured frontend, backend, and mobile applications. Introduced project standards and used observability to understand what needed attention.

items.body: National and international projects, including Tabas and Blueground. Frontend leadership for an e-commerce platform with authentication and payments.

contributions.title: Less waiting. More doing.
contributions.body: Improved application performance with caching and lazy loading across Next.js and Ruby on Rails, reducing load times and infrastructure costs.

contributions.title: Moving an internal tool into the modern web.
contributions.body: Joined the BlueBrain team to help replace a Java Applet with React, improving accessibility, performance, and resilience.

items.body: Consulting and web development for small businesses, with a focus on usable interfaces and better web performance.
Internal tools and CRUD applications using JavaScript, C#, ASP.NET, and SQL Server in an academic incubator.
